cues.zh: 人类爱吃肉。
cues.en: Humans love meat.

cues.zh: 牛排、炸鸡、培根、五花肉和香肠简直是最棒的东西！
cues.en: Steak, fried chicken, bacon, pork belly, and sausages are just the best things!

cues.zh: 吃肉已经变得如此稀松平常，以至于许多人
cues.en: Eating meat has become so trivial that many people

cues.zh: 觉得没有动物参与的饭就不算正经一餐。
cues.en: don't consider something a proper meal if there's no animal involved.

cues.zh: 这相当不可思议，
cues.en: Which is pretty amazing,

cues.zh: 因为就在几十年前，肉还是奢侈品。
cues.en: since only a few decades ago meat was a luxury product.

cues.zh: 如今，一美元就能买个芝士汉堡。
cues.en: Today, you can get a cheeseburger for a dollar.

cues.zh: 矛盾的是，肉几乎是喂养人类最低效的方式。
cues.en: Paradoxically, meat is pretty much the most inefficient way of feeding humans.

cues.zh: 放眼全球，我们的肉食饮食简直在吞噬地球。
cues.en: If we look at it on a global scale, our meaty diet is literally eating up the planet.

cues.zh: 为什么会这样，
cues.en: Why is that,

cues.zh: 我们又能做些什么，而不必放弃牛排？
cues.en: and what can we do about it, without giving up steak?

cues.zh: ♪ 抓耳的开场曲 ♪
cues.en: ♪ Catchy intro tune ♪

cues.zh: 人类饲养大量动物作为食物：
cues.en: Humans keep a lot of animals for food:

cues.zh: 目前约有230亿只鸡，
cues.en: Currently about 23 billion chickens,

cues.zh: 15亿头牛，
cues.en: 1.5 billion cattle,

cues.zh: 以及大约10亿头猪和羊。
cues.en: and roughly 1 billion pigs and sheep.

cues.zh: 要养活这么多张嘴，于是我们把地球变成了一个巨大的饲养场。
cues.en: That's a lot of mouths to feed, so we've transformed earth into a giant feeding ground.

cues.zh: 其83%的农田都用于畜牧业。
cues.en: 83% of its farmland is used for livestock.

cues.zh: 比如用作牧场，以及种植玉米和大豆等饲料作物。
cues.en: For example as pasture, and to farm fodder crops; like corn and soy.

cues.zh: 这占了地球陆地总面积的26%。
cues.en: That's 26% of earth's total land area.

cues.zh: 如果把种植这些植物所需的水也算上，
cues.en: If we include the water we need for these plants,

cues.zh: 肉类和奶制品生产就占了全球淡水消耗量的27%。
cues.en: meat and dairy production accounts for 27% of global freshwater consumption.

cues.zh: 遗憾的是，肉类生产就像资源的黑洞。
cues.en: Unfortunately; meat production is like a black hole for resources.

cues.zh: 因为动物是活物，它们吃进去的食物大部分都用来维持生命，
cues.en: Since animals are living things, most of their food is used to keep them alive,

cues.zh: 同时长出我们爱吃的部分。
cues.en: while they grow their tasty parts.

cues.zh: 饲料作物中的养分，只有一小部分最终留在了我们买到的肉里。
cues.en: Only a fraction of the nutrients from fodder crops end up in the meat we buy in the end.

cues.zh: 比如奶牛，只能把约4%的蛋白质
cues.en: Cows, for example, convert only about 4% of the proteins

cues.zh: 和3%的热量，从喂给它们的植物转化成牛肉。
cues.en: and 3% of the calories of the plants we feed to them into beef.

cues.zh: 超过97%的热量都流失了。
cues.en: More than 97% of the calories are lost to us.

cues.zh: 要产出一公斤牛排，一头牛最多要吃掉25公斤谷物，
cues.en: To create one kilogram of steak, a cow needs to eat up to 25 kilos of grain

cues.zh: 还要消耗多达15000升水。
cues.en: and uses up to 15,000 liters of water.

cues.zh: 动物制品吞噬了大量粮食，
cues.en: Animal products are guzzling up tons of food,

cues.zh: 但它们只占人类摄入热量的18%。
cues.en: but they only make up 18% of the calories humans eat.

cues.zh: 据预测，我们本可以多养活35亿人，
cues.en: According to projections, we could nourish an additional 3.5 billion people

cues.zh: 只要我们把喂给动物的粮食拿来自己吃。
cues.en: if we just ate the stuff we feed to animals.

cues.zh: 更让这最受欢迎的食物类别难以为继的是，
cues.en: To make our favorite food group even more unsustainable,

cues.zh: 人类造成的所有温室气体排放中，约15%
cues.en: about 15% of all greenhouse gas emissions caused by humans,

cues.zh: 来自肉类产业；
cues.en: are created by the meat industry;

cues.zh: 相当于所有船只、飞机、卡车和汽车排放的总和。
cues.en: as much as by all ships, planes, trucks and cars combined.

cues.zh: 而且……肉类还有另一个层面：
cues.en: And... there's another aspect to meat:

cues.zh: 它来自活生生的生命。
cues.en: It comes from actual living beings.

cues.zh: 猪、牛和鸡并不是书写历史的那一方，
cues.en: Pigs, cattle and chicken are not the ones writing the history books,

cues.zh: 但如果是的话，人类会显得像是猖獗的种族灭绝狂人，
cues.en: but if they were, humans would appear as rampant genocidal maniacs,

cues.zh: 靠苦难繁荣壮大。
cues.en: that thrive on suffering.

cues.zh: 全球范围内，我们每天要杀掉大约2亿只动物，
cues.en: Globally, we kill about 200 million animals every day,

cues.zh: 一年大约740亿只。
cues.en: about 74 billion a year.

cues.zh: 这意味着，每一年半，
cues.en: This means that every one and a half years,

cues.zh: 我们杀掉的动物数量，就超过了人类20万年历史中所有活过的人的总和。
cues.en: we kill more animals than people have lived in the entire 200,000 year history of humanity.

cues.zh: 有人可能会说，我们是在帮它们：
cues.en: One could argue that we're doing them a favor:

cues.zh: 毕竟，没有我们，它们根本不会存在。
cues.en: after all, they wouldn't exist without us.

cues.zh: 我们最终可能会吃掉它们，但我们也为它们提供了食物和住所，
cues.en: We might eat them in the end, but we also provide food and shelter,

cues.zh: 以及存在的恩赐。
cues.en: and the gift of existence to them.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，我们并不是很仁慈的神。
cues.en: Unfortunately, we're not very nice gods.

cues.zh: 我们的很多肉类来自工厂化养殖场：
cues.en: A lot of our meat comes from factory farms:

cues.zh: 巨大的工业化系统，圈养着成千上万只动物。
cues.en: huge industrial systems that house thousands of animals.

cues.zh: 为了尽可能高效而设计，
cues.en: Engineered to be as efficient as possible,

cues.zh: 它们几乎不顾及生活质量之类的事情。
cues.en: they have little regard for things like quality of life.

cues.zh: 大多数猪被养在巨大的无窗棚屋里，
cues.en: Most pigs are raised in gigantic windowless sheds,

cues.zh: 永远见不到太阳。
cues.en: and never get to see the sun.

cues.zh: 母猪被关在狭小得无法转身的栏里，
cues.en: Sows are kept in pens too small to turn around,

cues.zh: 在那里一胎接一胎地生猪仔，
cues.en: where they give birth to one litter of piglets after another,

cues.zh: 直到轮到它们被做成培根。
cues.en: until it's their turn to be turned into bacon.

cues.zh: 奶牛被迫不断繁殖以保证产奶，
cues.en: Dairy cows are forced to breed continually to ensure their milk supply,

cues.zh: 但产仔几小时后就和牛犊分开。
cues.en: but are separated from their calves hours after birth.

cues.zh: 为了让肉牛长肥待宰，它们被关进饲养场：
cues.en: To fatten up beef cattle for slaughter, they're put in feedlots:

cues.zh: 封闭的围栏里，它们无法活动，只能更快增重。
cues.en: Confined pens where they can't roam and put on weight more quickly.

cues.zh: 为了让它们如此密集地关在一起却不死于疾病，
cues.en: To make it possible to keep them so tightly together without dying of diseases,

cues.zh: 我们使用的抗生素大部分都用在了牲畜身上：
cues.en: the majority of antibiotics we use are for livestock:

cues.zh: 在美国高达80%。
cues.en: up to 80% in the US.

cues.zh: 这在短期内有帮助，但也助长了抗生素耐药性。
cues.en: Which helps in the short term, but also fuels antibiotic resistances.

cues.zh: 但待遇最惨的也许是鸡。
cues.en: But the ones that may have got the worst deal are chickens.

cues.zh: 在工厂化养殖场里，它们被养在数量极其庞大
cues.en: In factory farms, they're kept in such vast numbers

cues.zh: 且彼此如此靠近的环境中，无法形成它们在自然界中的社会结构，
cues.en: and so close to each other, that they can't form the social structures they have in nature,

cues.zh: 于是它们开始互相攻击。
cues.en: so they start attacking each other.

cues.zh: 为了阻止这种情况，我们切掉它们的喙和爪。
cues.en: To stop that we cut their beaks and claws.

cues.zh: 公鸡肉鸡被认为毫无价值：
cues.en: Male chickens are deemed worthless:

cues.zh: 因为它们不能下蛋，也不适合产肉。
cues.en: since they can't lay eggs and are not suitable for meat production.

cues.zh: 所以出生后几分钟内，它们通常被毒气熏死，再在研磨机里绞碎。
cues.en: So within minutes after birth, they're usually gassed and shredded in grinders.

cues.zh: 每年有数亿只小鸡这样被杀死。
cues.en: Several hundred million baby chickens are killed this way each year.

cues.zh: 就算你个人跟鸡有仇，
cues.en: Even if you had a personal score to settle with chickens,

cues.zh: 我们对待它们的方式也糟糕透顶。
cues.en: how we treat them is beyond broken.

cues.zh: 那买有机肉就好，动物被善待，对吧？
cues.en: So, better buy organic meat where animals are treated nicely, right?

cues.zh: 有机农业法规旨在给动物提供最低限度的舒适。
cues.en: Organic farming regulations are designed to grant animals a minimum of comfort.

cues.zh: 问题在于，“有机”是个弹性很大的词。
cues.en: The problem is that "organic" is an elastic term.

cues.zh: 根据欧盟法规，
cues.en: According to EU regulations,

cues.zh: 一只有机母鸡仍可能和另外五只共享一平方米空间。
cues.en: an organic hen still might share one square metre of space with five others.

cues.zh: 这跟快乐的农场鸡差得远了。
cues.en: That's a long way off from happy farmyard chickens.

cues.zh: 当然，真心尽力而为的农场确实存在，
cues.en: Farms that sincerely do their best do exist of course,

cues.zh: 但肉类仍然是一门生意。
cues.en: but meat is still a business.

cues.zh: 有机标签只是一种多收钱的手段，
cues.en: An organic label is a way to charge more money,

cues.zh: 无数丑闻揭露了生产商
cues.en: and countless scandals have revealed producers

cues.zh: 想方设法钻制度的空子。
cues.en: looking for ways to cheat the system.

cues.zh: 虽然有机肉可能没那么残忍，
cues.en: And while organic meat might be less cruel,

cues.zh: 但它比传统肉类生产需要更多资源。
cues.en: it needs even more resources than conventional meat production.

cues.zh: 所以，买有机仍然更可取，
cues.en: So, buying organic is still preferable,

cues.zh: 但并不能让你获得道德赦免。
cues.en: but does not grant you moral absolution.

cues.zh: 事实是，如果痛苦是一种资源：
cues.en: The truth is, if suffering were a resource:

cues.zh: 我们每年会制造数十亿吨。
cues.en: we would create billions of tons of it per year.

cues.zh: 我们对待动物的方式，很可能会成为未来世代鄙夷的事情之一。
cues.en: The way we treat animals will probably be one of the things future generations will look down on in disgust.

cues.zh: 虽然这些都是事实，但另一件事也是事实：
cues.en: While all these things are true, something else is true too:

cues.zh: 牛排太棒了；
cues.en: Steak is amazing;

cues.zh: 汉堡是最好的食物；
cues.en: Burgers are the best food;

cues.zh: 鸡翅味道超赞。
cues.en: Chicken wings taste great.

cues.zh: 肉能满足我们蜥蜴脑深处某种埋藏的需求。
cues.en: Meat satisfies something buried deep in our lizard brain.

cues.zh: 我们几乎从没见过肉是怎么生产出来的：
cues.en: We hardly ever see how our meat is made:

cues.zh: 我们只管吃，而且爱吃。
cues.en: we just eat it and love it.

cues.zh: 它带来快乐，让家人聚餐和烧烤派对把我们聚在一起。
cues.en: It creates joy, it brings us together for family meals and barbecue parties.

cues.zh: 吃肉不会让你变成坏人。
cues.en: Eating meat doesn't make you a bad person.

cues.zh: 不吃肉也不会让你变成好人。
cues.en: Not eating meat doesn't make you a good one.

cues.zh: 生活很复杂，我们创造的世界也很复杂。
cues.en: Life is complicated and so is the world we've created.

cues.zh: 那么，我们该如何面对这个事实：肉类生产极其不可持续，
cues.en: So, how should we deal with the fact that meat is extremely unsustainable,

cues.zh: 而且某种程度上是一种可怕的折磨？
cues.en: and a sort of horrible torture?

cues.zh: 目前，最简单的选择就是更经常地不吃肉。
cues.en: For now, the easiest option is opting out more often.

cues.zh: 每周有一天不吃肉，就已经能带来改变。
cues.en: Taking a meat-free day per week already makes a difference.

cues.zh: 如果你想吃到痛苦更少的肉：
cues.en: If you want to eat meat produced with less suffering:

cues.zh: 尽量从有良好记录的可靠生产商那里购买，
cues.en: try to buy from trusted producers with a good track record,

cues.zh: 哪怕价格更高。
cues.en: even if it costs more.

cues.zh: 若想对环境产生影响：
cues.en: To make an impact on the environment:

cues.zh: 选择鸡肉和猪肉，而不是羊肉和牛肉，
cues.en: go for chicken and pig, rather than lamb and beef,

cues.zh: 因为它们把饲料转化为肉的效率更高。
cues.en: as they convert their feed more efficiently into meat.

cues.zh: 既然你要吃牛排，那就该好好享用它！
cues.en: And if you're going to have your steak: you should eat it too!

cues.zh: 一个普通美国人每天扔掉近一磅食物，
cues.en: An average American throws out nearly a pound of food per day,

cues.zh: 其中很多是肉类。
cues.en: a lot of which is meat.

cues.zh: 未来，科学可以为我们带来清洁肉。
cues.en: In the future, science could get us clean meat.

cues.zh: 多家初创公司已成功在实验室培育出肉，
cues.en: Various startups have successfully grown meat in labs,

cues.zh: 并正努力实现商业化规模生产。
cues.en: and are working on doing so on a commercial scale.

cues.zh: 但这类解决方案还要等上几年。
cues.en: But solutions like this are still a few years away.

cues.zh: 眼下，好好享用你的牛排吧，
cues.en: For now, enjoy your steak,

cues.zh: 但也要心怀敬意。
cues.en: but also respect it.

cues.zh: 如果可以：让它重新变得特别起来。
cues.en: And if you can: make it something special again.
